% fancyvrb's \UseVerb writes its saved text inline, as in the PDF: in a
% paragraph, a heading and the table of contents, a footnote, a theorem,
% italic text, a table cell, a caption, and a box; with \UseVerb*,
% options, and \fvset's size; and \SaveGVerb's text with \UseMVerb. A
% saved block after them stays a display.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{xcolor,fancyvrb}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\SaveVerb{head}|uv-head_h|
\SaveGVerb{moving}|uv-moving_m|
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents
\SaveVerb{v}|uv-text_a#b%|
\SaveVerb{star}|uv-star a  b|
Text \UseVerb{v} more.

\section{Head \UseVerb{head} end}

Moving \UseMVerb{moving} text.

\subsection{Moving \UseMVerb{moving} head}

In a footnote.\footnote{Note \UseVerb{v} end.}

\begin{theorem}
Theorem \UseVerb{v} end.
\end{theorem}

\textit{Italic \UseVerb{v} end.}

\begin{tabular}{|l|}
\hline
Cell \UseVerb{v} end\\
\hline
\end{tabular}

\begin{figure}[h]
\centering
Figure body.
\caption{Caption \UseVerb{v} end}
\end{figure}

\fbox{Box \UseVerb{v} end}

Star \UseVerb*{star} end.

Shape \UseVerb[fontshape=it]{v} end.

{\fvset{fontsize=\small}Small \UseVerb{v} end.}

\begin{SaveVerbatim}{blk}
uv-block a_b
\end{SaveVerbatim}
After the inline text.
\UseVerbatim{blk}
Last line.
\end{document}
